svg.title: Enterprise AgentGateway brokered elicitation flow
svg.desc: Sixteen-step animation. One-time consent: an MCP client is rejected by the AGW proxy, runs a PKCE OAuth flow against the AGW OAuth issuer, which signs the user in through Entra ID, obtains an upstream OAuth token, stores it encrypted in Postgres and relays the Entra token to the client. Every MCP request: the proxy validates the Entra JWT, exchanges it at the STS for the stored upstream token, and calls the upstream MCP server with that token.

g.text: Client POSTs /mcp with no token; proxy MCP authn rejects it
Client opens /oauth-issuer/authorize; issuer saves flow state
Issuer redirects the user to Entra (its own PKCE pair)
Entra → /callback/downstream; code exchanged, user_id = ID token sub
Consent interstitial; skipped when a completed elicitation exists
Redirect to upstream authorize: clientId, scopes, PKCE (pkce: Always)
Issuer exchanges code at accessTokenUrl (client_secret + verifier)
Token stored envelope-encrypted; elicitation (user, backend) completed
Issuer code → client; /oauth-issuer/token relays the Entra token unchanged
issuer README "does not mint tokens" · log "token exchange successful"
Client POSTs /mcp with Bearer; proxy validates, then strips the header
STS resolves user (sub) and loads the token; refreshes if near expiry
sts/handler.go · secret/client.go (refresh in the last 10% of lifetime)
STS returns the stored upstream access token
Proxy sets Authorization: Bearer <upstream token> and calls upstream
